description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role 

We are looking for a Senior Professional Services Consultant – Zero Trust Branch Specialist to join our team. This is a Remote (United States) role reporting to the Director, Professional Services in the Professional Services department. As a key field resource, you will deliver deployment advisory and implementation services to enterprise customers adopting the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform, focusing on Zero Trust Branch, Branch Connector, and distributed site transformation. You will partner closely with customer Network, Security, and Infrastructure teams, delivery partners, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering to design and deploy scalable solutions—traveling to customer locations as needed for short-term engagements to drive successful customer outcomes.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Lead end-to-end customer engagements from discovery and architectural assessment through design, wave-based rollouts, cutover, and operational handover
  • Design and deploy Zscaler Zero Trust Branch solutions across distributed sites, including Internet breakout, private application access, segmentation, hybrid connectivity, and migrations from legacy firewalls or SD-WAN
  • Apply expertise across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange portfolio, including ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and Data Protection capabilities.
  • Leverage automation, REST APIs, and Infrastructure as Code to build scalable, repeatable deployment workflows and reusable technical deliverables
  • Lead technical workshops, validation testing, and knowledge-transfer sessions while partnering with Support, Product, and Engineering to resolve complex deployment issues
  • Coach and enable delivery partners on design standards and operational checklists, traveling to customer locations as needed for short-term engagements

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are customer-obsessed, translating complex enterprise branch, datacenter WAN, and security challenges into practical, scalable solutions that drive measurable customer outcomes.
  • You are a problem-solver who thrives on diagnosing and resolving intricate connectivity, routing, and policy challenges across distributed sites.
  • You act like an owner, taking full accountability for customer engagements and balancing deep technical expertise with pragmatic, hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who partners seamlessly across customer Network, Security, and Infrastructure teams, delivery partners, and internal engineering and support functions.
  • You are driven by innovation, actively exploring and applying automation, APIs, and AI-enabled tools to continuously improve delivery workflows and problem solving.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • Consulting or Professional Services experience designing and implementing enterprise networking, network security, or Zero Trust solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform
  • Hands-on experience deploying branch edge or datacenter networking and security solutions, including SD-WAN, branch firewalls, Routers, or Cloud Connector technologies
  • Strong understanding of branch and datacenter networking and core protocols, including VLANs, routing (static, BGP, OSPF), DHCP, DNS, NAT, high availability, WAN connectivity, TCP/IP, IPsec, GRE, and HTTP/HTTPS
  • Experience with scripting, REST APIs, or Infrastructure as Code, along with familiarity with Git
  • Hands-on network troubleshooting experience using tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, traceroute, or MTR, paired with strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Deep expertise in Zscaler Zero Trust Branch, Branch Connector, and advanced Zero Trust Exchange capabilities (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, SSL Inspection, Cloud Browser Isolation, and NSS)
  • Experience leading multi-site, multi-region wave-based branch rollouts and migrating customers from legacy platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Cisco to Zero Trust architectures
  • Experience with campus and datacenter networking transformation, retail environments, and large distributed enterprise deployments
  • Experience with network segmentation, microsegmentation, IoT/OT environments, and network automation using Terraform, Ansible, or Python, alongside relevant industry certifications (such as CCIE, CISSP, JNCIE, NSE, or PCNSE)
